{{Quote|When Sith have nightmares, I am the face they see.|Darth Phobos|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
After she was betrayed and nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brethren, the [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Phobos]] organized a fanatical '''cult''' devoted to her. She employed the [[Sith cult/Legends|cultists]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith leaders, which led those two rival factions to join forces and [[Battle against Darth Phobos|kill]] Phobos. Phobos' cult existed for long afterward, but eventually disappeared as well.

==History==
[[File:Phobos.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Darth Phobos, the cult's leader and the object of worship]]
A fanatical cult was created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Phobos]] many [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="TFU databank" /> prior to [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" /> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Phobos was a manipulative [[Sentience/Legends|being]] who [[Death/Legends|murdered]] many of her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brethren in a bid for power. Her fellow Sith eventually turned against her and destroyed her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while it was in low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the Sith burial-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The Sith believed that she was killed, but Phobos had survived the attempt on her life and went into hiding. She organized a [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] devoted solely to her and worshipped her as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]].<ref name="TFU databank" />

Phobos then sent her agents across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to recruit more members and to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith leaders. The latter faction eventually began to suspect that Phobos was still at large and began referring to her as "The Hidden Fear." Recognizing the cult as a major threat to the galaxy, Jedi and Sith overcame their differences to join forces, and killed Phobos in [[Battle against Darth Phobos|battle]]. However, her cult continued to exist for years, disappearing only around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Fourth Great Schism|Great Schism]] of 2000 BBY.<ref name="TFU databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cult of Darth Phobos was mentioned in Darth Phobos' databank entry in the [[Krome Studios]]-developed [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.<ref name="TFU databank" />
